intent: Show a person or entity as a round picture, with initials or an icon until the picture loads or when it fails

properties.description: Image source. The image part shows once it has loaded; without a src the fallback shows.
Accessible name of the picture; set, it names the host (role=img) and the image itself gets alt="".
The person or entity: names the host when alt is empty, and its initials (up to two letters) are the fallback when none is authored.
sm 6u (the slot), md 8u (the control height), lg 12u, xl 16u. Initials and icon scale with it.
Milliseconds before the fallback shows (Base UI Fallback delay), so a fast image does not flash initials.

events.name: loadingstatuschange
events.trigger: the image starts loading, loads or fails, or src is cleared

content.children: Fallback content (initials text or an icon); optionally an authored and [data-part=fallback].

constraints: The host sets role=img and aria-label from alt, else name; without either it sets no role and the image's alt (or the fallback text) is read.
The image shows only once it has loaded; the fallback shows while it loads, after an error and without a src, after delay ms.
Fallback content: authored children win; else the initials of name (up to two letters); else a user icon.
Sizes are avatar-size sm | md | lg | xl (6u | 8u | 12u | 16u); size sets u for the subtree as everywhere else.
Tone colors are the application's: an author class (bg and color roles) overrides the neutral fill.

avoidWhen.when: A content image or photo with its own aspect ratio.
avoidWhen.reason: An avatar is a round square for a person or entity.

avoidWhen.when: A status dot or a count over the avatar.
avoidWhen.reason: The kit has no avatar badge or group overlap; compose a badge beside it.

nodes.summary: The picture (Base UI Avatar.Image): hidden until it has loaded; data-loading while loading, data-error after a failure. Covers the frame.
Shown until the image has loaded (Base UI Avatar.Fallback): authored content, else initials at the control font × k, else a user icon at the md icon × k.
